pages.text: $(item)Dilithium Ore$() grows in the Nether's netherrack, Y 10 to 110; an $(thing)iron pickaxe$() mines it into $(item)Dilithium Crystal$().

You need it early:$(li)Holding $(item)Dilithium Crystal$() once teaches the research symbols $(thing)∂²f/∂x²$() (second partial derivative) and $(thing)∂f/∂x$() (partial derivative) - the derivation of $(thing)Quantum Foundations$() needs them. $(li)It goes into $(item)Neutronium Plates$() (step 9), which most later parts are made of.$(br2)While you are in the Nether: blazes and ghasts are worth observing with the Spectral Analyzer (next step), and the Nether sky is worth Insight too.
